text:
mira: Heads-up — onboarding NovaCorp's LoRA adapter (cust-nova). Did a merge + int4 quant smoke run and saw token-level brevity on instruction-style prompts. cc @anika @sam :eyes:

anika: Sending a quick-eval pack to the thread in ~5m. Will include the instruction-run, conv-run, and our regression set.

sam: Thanks. What's our floating baseline (non-quant, merged)? Link to last eval?

leo: Baseline (fp16 merged) from last week: BLEU 0.74, ROUGE-L 0.66, avg_resp_len 142. Int4 run I did with int4-kernel-A: BLEU 0.70, ROUGE-L 0.62, avg_resp_len 129. Not huge perf drop but responses get cut earlier on certain instruction templates.

mira: Repro steps I used:
```bash
./eval_quickpack.sh --customer nova --adapter lora-nova-v3 --merge-mode stitch --quant int4 --seed 42 --suites instruction,conv,regress
# quick outputs: bleu: 0.703, rouge-l: 0.619, resp_len_delta: -9%
```

jordan: Can you paste the exact prompt that gets truncated? We should check tokenizer offsets / special token handling. Might be token ID shift from adapter merge.

mira: Example prompt that truncates:
"""
System: You are an assistant that explains thermostat schedules.
User: Explain how to set a weekday schedule for thermostats, step by step.
"""
Quantized model returns a shorter second paragraph, cuts off before giving the heating schedule.

anika: CI run (quickpack) finished: ci-bot reported 12/14 smoke checks passed. Failing tests are the long-instruction regression + a rerank stability test. Pasting CI snippet: 

ci-bot: model-merge-smoke / build-8345: PASSED 12, FAILED 2. See /ci/8345/logs

leo: I checked KV-cache alignment logs — there's a repeated warning at token 45: "kvcache_index_mismatch" for the merged adapter path only. Not present in fp16 baseline. Could be merge ordering or adapter scale.

mira: Plan proposal:
1) Re-run eval with adapter-rescale=0.8 and adapter-rescale=0.6 to see sensitivity.
2) Run a tokenizer-offset check: compare tokenization of prompt across base|merged|quantized.
3) Run prefix-only inference (disable kvcache reuse) to isolate cache vs tokenizer.
4) If still repro, try re-merge using stitch-mode=overlap instead of stitch to see if token alignment improves.

sam: I'll run step 2 & 3 on my workstation. Can you drop the failing test IDs and example inputs?

mira: Failing tests: regress_long_instruct_001, rerank_stability_07. Pushing test inputs to /shared/evals/nova/failing_inputs.tar.gz in 2m.

anika: FYI I did a quick soft-merge (no rescale) and got a smaller delta on conv tasks but same long-instruction cut. Might be an interaction between LoRA merge order and int4 kernel packing.

leo: Quick hack I want to try: remerge with adapter-rescale=0.7 and enable force-int8-prefix (local flag) to see if lower-precision prefix packing helps.

jordan: If it's a tokenizer offset, could be adapter added tokens or special handling in merge. Also check whether LoRA used different dtype for embeddings during merge.

mira: Ongoing: I'm reproducing locally now with two seeds and will upload per-test diffs. If anyone sees a clear hypothesis, ping here.

sam: On it — starting token-diff script now. ETA ~20m.

ci-bot: /ci/8346: Triggered by @anika — running merge-rescale sweep (0.6,0.7,0.8). Will post summary when done.

anika: Thanks — let's try to keep customer impact low: if we can't stabilize int4 for NovaCorp, fallback policy = serve fp16 merged for that account and mark in rollout config.

mira: Agreed. Contingency = pin to fp16 & enable short-term A/B to monitor cost impact.

leo: Noted — I'll prepare a short runbook for ops with commands to pin route and rollback.

mira: Great. I'll compile findings + diffs and post a summary in ~1h. :thumbsup:

jordan: thx — ping me if you want a quick pair-debug on the kvcache logs.

sam: token-diff output (snippet):
```
PROMPT TOKENS (base): [101, 559, 233, 904, ... , 789]
PROMPT TOKENS (merged int4): [101, 559, 233, 904, ... , 790]  # off by +1 at position 18
```

mira: that +1 at pos 18 looks like the root cause. Looks like merge introduced a special-token remap for a locale marker in Nova adapter. Will trace adapter vocab changes next.

anika: Good find. If merge altered special token mapping we should regenerate tokenizer mapping and re-run merge.

mira: Opening a GH issue with traces + reproducer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4587

ci-bot: /ci/8346: sweep complete. Results: rescale=0.6 -> long_instruct pass, rescale=0.7 -> flaky, rescale=0.8 -> fail. Full matrix at /ci/8346/results.json

mira: Nice — rescale=0.6 looks promising. I'll validate on a larger holdout and then we can push a canary for NovaCorp on dedicated pool with rescale=0.6.

anika: I'll prepare the canary config and coordinate with product for customer opt-in.

mira: Closing loop later with full summary. Thanks team. :rocket:
